observations: 2017 Journal of Cardiology study of renal function and recurrence after second-generation cryoballoon ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.

entities.name: Renal function and ablation recurrence
observations: In an observational cohort of 110 patients followed for mean 9 months, recurrence was 7%, 12%, and 46% for eGFR ≥90, 60–89.9, and 30–59.9 mL/min/1.73 m²; higher eGFR predicted lower recurrence hazard (HR 0.97, 95% CI 0.93–0.99; p=0.047). Non-PV ectopy independently predicted recurrence (HR 2.92) and was more frequent at lower eGFR, suggesting but not proving mediation.
